Raymond: Hi team — onboarding hit a snag. Our Node SDK preflight is getting intermittent 401s and short 429 bursts when our CI spins up ~40 parallel workers. Logs show token failures around refresh time. Any quick mitigations?

Priya: thanks Raymond — can you paste a small log chunk? Are the 401s tied to refresh attempts or the initial handshake?

Raymond: snippet: `{"status":401,"route":"/v1/generate","msg":"invalid token","ts":"2026-03-21T09:01:12Z"}` and another: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` + header `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0`

Alex: likely preflight fanout + token TTL edge cases. If your CI spawns 40 workers they all might request fresh tokens at once. SDK defaults to light preflight caching; can you try lowering parallelism or enable client-side token caching?

Ben: also check auth-server clock skew grace window and token TTL. If tokens are issued with very short TTL and workers use them close to expiry, we see intermittent 401s. I can temporarily relax the window for your org while you adjust.

Priya: quick repro step — can you run this and paste the headers: `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/status`

Raymond: ran it a few times: got 200, 401, 200, 429 in a ~30s window. timestamps: 09:00:59 200, 09:01:12 401, 09:01:18 200, 09:01:25 429. Looks correlated with CI job spin-up.

Alex: try this SDK tweak (Node example) — reduces preflight concurrency and adds jitter/backoff and token cache so workers share short-lived tokens: 

```
const client = new Redwood({
  preflightConcurrency: 5,
  tokenCacheTtl: 30, // seconds
  retry: { retries: 5, minTimeout: 200, maxTimeout: 2000, randomize: true }
});
```

Alex: that should avoid 40 simultaneous preflight handoffs.

Ben: I'm going to bump the onboarding rate window for org-482 by 2x for the next 12 hours while you finish integration. Will follow up if I need to revert.

deploy-bot: canary auth-config update rolled out to 3 nodes (auth-window +2x) — 09:12 UTC

Raymond: After lowering concurrency and applying the SDK config the 401s stopped and 429s are much less frequent. CI passed the quick suite. Thanks!

Priya: awesome — I'll write up a short onboarding note: recommended SDK settings for heavy parallel CI, token-refresh checklist, and a fallback pattern. Ben — please keep the temporary window live until EOD tomorrow and we'll reassess.

Ben: on it. I'll also add a quick metric to track refresh-rate spikes for future onboarding runs.
